_note: The docker run argument list the benchmark's launch script (case flash-b12x) produced for the 2026-10-27/28 benchmark (captured with a recording docker stand-in; home directory shown as ~). test_presets.py checks the Quality preset against it.
argv:
S=/opt/b12x-seed/preparation; D="$XDG_CACHE_HOME/b12x/compile/preparation"; mkdir -p "$D" && for f in "$S"/*.json; do [ -e "$D/$(basename "$f")" ] || cp "$f" "$D/"; done
        A=/opt/b12x-seed/torch_compile_cache; mkdir -p "$VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/torch_compile_cache" && cp -rn "$A/." "$VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/torch_compile_cache/" || true
        exec vllm serve ursuciprian/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-GDN-MSE --revision 03f4a0570496bbe741189f4a2a7d611679e85406 \
          --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code --served-model-name flash-b12x \
          --tensor-parallel-size 1 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --mamba-cache-mode align \
          --enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill --max-parallel-prefills 4 \
          --prefill-policy decode-aware --decode-refill-target auto --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
          --quantization modelopt_mixed --block-size 16 --load-format b12x --max-model-len 262144 \
          --max-num-seqs 8 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
          --speculative-config "{\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":4,\"draft_sample_method\":\"probabilistic\"}" \
          --gdn-decode-kernel b12x --linear-backend b12x --moe-backend b12x --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
          --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-auto-tool-choice --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
          --default-chat-template-kwargs "{\"reasoning_effort\":\"medium\"}" \
          --compilation-config "{\"pass_config\":{\"fuse_act_quant\":true}}" \
          --kv-cache-memory-bytes 15032385536 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.01
